question: Bitcoin (BTC) closing price above $65,000 on August 11, 2026?

model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the price of Bitcoin (BTC) in USD as reported by CoinGecko (coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin) at 7:45 PM EDT on August 11, 2026. Resolves to "Yes" if the CoinGecko-reported BTC/USD price at the observation time is strictly greater than $65,000.00. Resolves to "No" if the price is equal to or less than $65,000.00. If CoinGecko is unavailable at the observation time, the price is taken from CoinGecko as soon as it becomes available thereafter, reflecting the closest available data point to 7:45 PM EDT on August 11, 2026.
